objective: Original judges' noisy Z/X score at 10000 shots per basis; K=N and K=min(4,N)

hypotheses.claim: Correct Z dispersion scaling and omit relative attenuation penalties for zero target correlators when ranking placements.
hypotheses.mechanism: The official Z penalty amplifies nonuniformity by 10000/M; average gate fidelity alone misses it.
hypotheses.screen: Analytic corrected denominator, then exact small independent-Pauli/readout denominator.
hypotheses.falsifier: No improvement in calibrated-QVM score or poor agreement on unseen calibration maps.

hypotheses.claim: Merge redundant local/echo pulses and repack operations to reduce Markov-noise exposure.
hypotheses.mechanism: Paired echo pulses do not refocus memoryless damping/depolarization, but add gate error and duration.
hypotheses.screen: Exact single-qubit fusion and identity elimination with all CZ dependencies retained.
hypotheses.falsifier: No score gain, or losses on independent relaxation/dephasing stress tests.

hypotheses.claim: A global terminal X on balanced Dicke states can reduce asymmetric noise bias.
hypotheses.mechanism: X^N stabilizes D(N,N/2) exactly, while swapping the preparation's noisy populations before asymmetric readout.
hypotheses.screen: Compare native fused terminal-X frame against the unchanged circuit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Additional gate noise outweighs any imbalance reduction.

hypotheses.claim: Exact collective-Z and balanced-X output symmetries plus native scheduling can shorten some Problem 2 circuits.
hypotheses.mechanism: Dicke states are eigenstates of collective Z rotations, and balanced Dicke states of global X; fusion may eliminate a critical-path final gate.
hypotheses.screen: Try only symmetry-preserving changes, count full native moments, verify any strict depth improvement.
hypotheses.falsifier: No strictly shorter exact physical circuit.

hypotheses.claim: Exact local Pauli frames around CZ gates can reduce systematic coherent-error accumulation.
hypotheses.mechanism: For P=Pauli_a tensor Pauli_b, Q=CZ P-dagger CZ is also local Pauli; Q CZ P equals ideal CZ up to phase, while actual systematic errors change orientation. Frames can fuse into existing single-qubit gates.
hypotheses.motivation: For D(8,4), cheap independent-noise denominator is 1.17 while full-QVM Z penalty alone is 4.01. Isolate coherent errors by ablation before attributing the gap.
hypotheses.screen: Compare a small preregistered set of deterministic seed frames in complex64 full-QVM density simulation, then validate finalists in complex128 with new shot seeds.
hypotheses.falsifier: No full-QVM gain, extra pulse noise dominates, or gain disappears under coherent-sign/calibration stress.

hypotheses.claim: Local coordinate search over exact CZ frames can improve the best seeded frame pattern further.
hypotheses.mechanism: Different CZ errors contribute differently to final Z-shell imbalance. Altering one exact Pauli frame changes coherent interference without changing ideal preparation or CZ count.
hypotheses.motivation: H5 screened D(8,4) frame seeds improve calibrated score by roughly 48-55% while most D(6,3) frames lose; search must be state-specific and independently validated.
hypotheses.screen: At most 48 deterministic complex64 full-noise evaluations, ordered by supplied coupler error. Optimize the finite-shot expected original denominator without resampling noise; require at least 0.5% improvement per accepted step.
hypotheses.falsifier: No further denominator improvement, or fresh complex128 median-score validation fails.

hypotheses.claim: Optimize a frame pattern across multiple placements to reduce calibration-specific gains.
hypotheses.mechanism: Minimize mean normalized expected judge denominator plus half the worst normalized denominator on three training patches, rather than the nominal patch alone.
hypotheses.motivation: D(7,3) and D(8,3) nominal seed wins fail some held-out physical placements, unlike D(8,4).
hypotheses.screen: At most 24 frame-coordinate proposals on nominal plus two predefined patches. Reserve fourth and fifth distinct placements and coherent-sign inversion for fresh validation.
hypotheses.falsifier: No nominal improvement or unacceptable loss on either reserved placement or sign-inverted noise.

promotion_rules: No approximate ideal Dicke state, forbidden feedback, unavailable coupler or runtime-limit violation.
Screen with cheap models and at most 128 score resamplings; never replace the official 10000-shot objective with a lower-shot objective.
Validate finalists in calibrated Willow noise, independently of screening proxy.
Use fresh resampling seeds, both K settings, and matched coverage; retain all negative results.
Keep the incumbent untouched until evidence supports promotion; distinguish calibration-specific records from general improvements.
